about: One entry per file in this directory, written by studio/dev/media_capture.py after each capture and checked by tests/test_version.py. version and commit: the app the pixels came from (commit is the HEAD the capture ran on, '+dirty' when studio/ or pacer/ had uncommitted changes; entries backfilled on 2026-09-30 name the commit that added the file). source: a label, never a path. derived: the published file this one was cut from, whose version, commit and waiver it carries. waiver: why a file older than this minor release stays, and the version it was granted at; it lapses at the next minor release.

waiver.reason: not re-rendered at 0.9.0: the source recording (Sandown 3h) is not on this machine as of 2026-11-15; captured at 0.2.0 (acf6b0c) by the export renderer; 0.6.0's export of overlay.jpg's frame differed from it in the track-map inset (0.48 % of decoded pixels), and 0.6.1 moved the overlay's Δ onto on-track alignment (#512, the Δ overlay.jpg was re-shot to show), so the clip's Δ readout likely differs from a current export; 0.7.0 and 0.8.0 touched no export code, and 0.9.0's one export change is #555 moving the map inset's comet tail (trace_tail) from export_video.py to timeline.py, its body the same but for a typing cast and its 2.4 s constant renamed TRACE_TAIL_S (git diff v0.8.0..HEAD); a regression lane reported an 18 s 720p overlay export byte-identical to v0.8.0's (file hash and every frame hash)
